text: A man who hides you on weekends is not busy. He is booked.
If you're saved as a number, you're one of several.
"I'll refund you tomorrow" has never once been followed by tomorrow.
Rich men don't need your signature. Broke men do.
Not every locked phone is hiding a lover. Some are hiding a man who is tired.
Loud men are not always dangerous. Quiet ones are not always safe.
Checking once is caution. Checking again is a hobby. Posting it is a war.
Control isn't love. Leaving isn't failure.
If her love language is alerts, you are a subscription.
Every "emergency" that needs your money is someone else's plan.
Sanity is a currency too. You spent all of it on him.
Blue ticks are a full sentence.
The Parlour doesn't forget. It just waits for a better picture.
You read the signs before they read you. That's not luck. That's attention.
Exclusive is a status, not a promise.
Being chosen feels good. Make sure you chose too.
You saw the signs. Next time, believe them.
